symptom: the whole bus went dark mid-session: scan returns nothing at all now, every device dropped off, and it worked yesterday. Nothing was re-plugged except a new module.

dmesg_tail: i2c-1 i2c-1: SDA is held low, bus recovery failed

gold.diagnosis: SDA held low with bus recovery failing means the newly added module is clamping the data line — a shorted/faulty device dragging the whole bus down. This is a hardware fault: STOP coding; disconnect the new module, check its wiring and VCC.
